proof_boundary: This proves exact terminal carrier specialization, uniform terminal channel bounds, row-relative collapse of F_(alpha_N)(log N) to mathcal N_(p,xi), an h-scale lower-endpoint S_1 bound, and conditional quadratic endpoint suppression. It proves no signed terminal kernel, complete outer-complement or quadratic residual bound, signed full-current or Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Q209, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: At lambda=log N, R=i b u_N, R+delta=chi_N, and R_x=i(b_xu_N+b u_(N,x)).
rows.claim: The centered physical rates collapse exactly at lambda=log N.
rows.proof_boundary: No observation sign follows.

rows.certificate: C_N=C(-u_N), A_N=i b u_NC_N, Q_N=chi_NC_N+D_N, and mathcal N_N=i b u_NQ_N+i(b_xu_N+b u_(N,x))C_N.

rows.proof_boundary: The correction channels remain exact.

rows.proof_boundary: It is complex and not signed.

rows.claim: The correction-free endpoint contraction has one order-one term.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not the complete physical row.

rows.claim: The terminal value polynomial is uniformly close to one.
rows.proof_boundary: The retained row multiplying it is not bounded.

rows.claim: The terminal correction-current polynomial remains fourth order in h.
rows.proof_boundary: This is coefficient control only.

rows.certificate: |A_N|<8h/5, |Q_N|<8h/5, and |mathcal N_N|<17h^2/10.
rows.claim: The other three terminal carrier channels are h or h-squared scale.
rows.proof_boundary: No aggregate norm is inferred.

rows.certificate: |F_(alpha_N)(log N)-mathcal N_(p,xi)|<(8/5)h R_alpha, with R_alpha the l1 norm of alpha_N.
rows.claim: The complete alpha-row terminal coefficient collapses to one observation.
rows.proof_boundary: R_alpha remains a retained row norm.

rows.claim: The lower physical endpoint has an h-scale conditional kernel.
rows.proof_boundary: The factor log a can still occur in a lift.

rows.certificate: At u=1, a_1>3alpha_P/5 and 0<b_1-a_1<1+alpha_P/(N+1/2); integrating psi'=zeta(2,.) gives 0<S_1^[N](alpha_P)<5/N<=(15/2)h.
rows.claim: Both lower-endpoint Hurwitz arguments are large and close on the reciprocal scale.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not bound S_1 at u=N.

rows.certificate: For ell_mu=log(mu/a), the first conditional endpoint trace obeys B_mu^(1)[dot P]=i ell_mu B_mu^(1)[P].
rows.claim: The conditional trace of a lifted observation has an exact logarithmic factor.
rows.proof_boundary: Higher endpoint kernels remain separate.

rows.certificate: At mu=N, ell_N=-u_N with |ell_N|<2h. At mu=1, ell_1=-log a while B_1^(1) already contains S_1^[N](alpha_P)=O(h).
rows.claim: Each physical endpoint supplies a distinct h mechanism.
rows.proof_boundary: No cross-endpoint product is estimated here.

rows.certificate: Every S_1-by-S_1 quadratic endpoint term contains at least one terminal u_N factor or one lower-endpoint S_1^[N](alpha_P) factor. This is an h-suppression template, not a complete quadratic bound.
rows.claim: No S_1-by-S_1 quadratic endpoint term is coefficientwise unsuppressed.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a full quadratic remainder bound.

rows.certificate: The sole order-one terminal conditional coefficient is mathcal N_(p,xi); all other terms in F_(alpha_N)(log N) are bounded by (8/5)h R_alpha.
rows.claim: Only mathcal N_(p,xi) survives at order one in the terminal conditional trace.
rows.proof_boundary: Its sign and phase remain open.

rows.certificate: Derive the source-specific reciprocal-band/Hermitian/transpose cancellation or sign for the mathcal N_(p,xi) S_1^[N](alpha_P/N) endpoint kernel.
rows.claim: Prove or falsify the unique source-specific terminal endpoint kernel.
rows.proof_boundary: No cancellation theorem is proved.

rows.certificate: At a reciprocal integer tie, transfer the complete mode and its endpoint rows before differentiating.
rows.claim: The endpoint specialization remains inside the joined half-open band convention.
rows.proof_boundary: No complement-only derivative is allowed.

rows.certificate: Do not remove beta_E merely because the alpha row is leading.
rows.claim: The h-suppressed genuine edge from Section 11.182 remains beside the alpha-row obstruction.
rows.proof_boundary: The full P_lin row is retained.

rows.certificate: The common phase cancels from H_out and is squared in T_out.
rows.claim: Hermitian and transpose phases remain distinct.
rows.proof_boundary: No imaginary coefficient is discarded.

rows.certificate: Insert the exact moving-tail defect once after the endpoint kernel is formed.
rows.claim: The terminal motion remains a separate retained package.
rows.proof_boundary: No atomic-to-row norm promotion is made.

rows.certificate: Use the certified h^2 coefficient perturbation only after the ideal endpoint kernel is grouped.
rows.claim: The row-relative collapse does not delete the correction perturbation.
rows.proof_boundary: No absolute six-coefficient split is introduced.

rows.certificate: Start from mathcal N_(p,xi)S_1^[N](alpha_P/N), then compose the returned carrier, H_out, T_out, and terminal recurrence.
rows.claim: The next arithmetic target is one scalar observation coefficient times one joined endpoint kernel.
rows.proof_boundary: No sign follows from row reduction alone.

rows.certificate: The only pi occurs in u_(N,x)=h^2/(8pi) and the inherited Fourier normalization.
rows.claim: No new geometric pi enters the terminal specialization.
rows.proof_boundary: No plotted symmetry is used.

rows.certificate: The unsuppressed mathcal N_(p,xi) coefficient remains the live obstruction.
rows.claim: Endpoint h suppression is not promoted to an h^2 flow estimate.
rows.proof_boundary: No retained-current theorem follows.

rows.claim: This is an endpoint obstruction reduction, not a proof of RH.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a proof of RH.
